name: Close button
summary: The X button that closes or removes something. One building block for Tag, Alert, Toast, Modal and Slideout, so the size, hover and hit area are the same everywhere.
use: Inside MyUI components: you get it through Tag, Alert, Toast, Modal and Slideout.
avoid: As a general icon button in your own layout: use Button icon.
anatomy: Hit area of at least 24 px.
figmaProps: xs: Tag. sm: Alert and Toast. md: Modal and Slideout.
reactProps: Default 'sm'. Internal component: not exported from the package.
Required. Comes from the labels of the component that uses it, for example labels.close.
behaviour: The hover surface and hit area sit outside the icon (negative margin), so in the layout the button takes up only the icon size.
a11y: Native <button type="button"> with an aria-label. The icon is aria-hidden.
The hit area is at least 24 by 24 px (WCAG 2.5.8).
content: Name what it closes when that is not clear: "Remove Design" on a Tag, "Close" in a dialog.
do: Use the size of the component it sits in.
dont: An X without an accessible name.
open: Figma has no Focus state yet; the code uses the standard focus ring.
